args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion, raised by Sofia Marchetti in #coastal-team:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals', so the old name is still showing in at least one place.
- Worth checking which accounts and saved reports still use the Covey & Lark label, so the name is consistent.

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti (drafted by assistant)
